decisions.reason: The future-location template decision does not necessarily change the hub's existing role, location routing, navigation, or booking ownership.
The candidate already has a same-message MODIFY covering consistent branding across current and future location sites; the template scalability decision adds no further brand-state change.
The candidate already captures the same message's visual direction for the master site and location pages; addability without redesign does not necessarily alter those visual attributes.
Making future locations addable without redesigning the site does not change the specified master-site domain.
The source decision concerns reusable site structure and does not change the Wix Bookings platform requirement.
Support for adding future location pages without redesign does not itself change per-location booking, revenue, sales, calendar, or management isolation.
